description: This file defines the class FormatWithPurgeString implementing the ValueFormatter interface. It provides a method to return a fixed string 'Purged' regardless of input, used in the context of formatting values within a purge strategy in the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeString
classes.description: A class that implements the ValueFormatter interface to provide a formatted value for maintenance purge strategy, always returning 'Purged'.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the string 'Purged' regardless of the input parameter.
